measured_time_subtotals.scope: Actual measured segment timers; the initial source validation before invocation.json and shell/Python startup are not timed here. Sum segment orchestration includes measured planning, verification, reduction, transitions and full GPU subprocess incl lock wait/setup/save; not a complete shell-launch stopwatch.

limitations: Single serialized cold/new-process campaign under current cache and load conditions; no repeated-run distribution or cold-filesystem mean.
Baseline lacks per-stage orchestration timing, so no inferred full-campaign speed ratio is reported.
A loop RTF gain must not hide planning/startup/model-switch waits.
Exact saved metrics do not include every contact Jacobian/individual contact point; all available raw state/force/policy arrays are compared.
Body/pose equality is limited to this model and command configuration.
Three different active-window MJBs remain measured-state continuation, not one persistent solver or379DOF dynamics equivalence.

process_elapsed_observation.residual_interpretation: Upper-bound residual includes initial validation/process startup outside segment timers and exit-observation lag. It is not an exact startup duration.

audit_script.execution: CPU read-only archive, JSON, SHA and timing comparison; no physics or GPU execution.
